This file is the source of truth for ownership/routing rules.

Assign issues by choosing the team with the strongest overlap
spans.note: The prompt establishes a clear source of truth for routing rules and provides explicit, well-defined team ownership categories. It instructs the agent to assign based on 'strongest overlap,' promoting accurate categorization rather than guessing or fabricating assignments.

spans.text: Do not add labels to issues. Only assign an owner.
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates good tool safety practices by restricting available tools to only 'github-triage' (all other tools are disabled with '"*": false'), limiting the scope of actions to only assignment (no label changes), and constraining team values to a fixed set. This follows the principle of least privilege.
